answer_1.quote: we append classification choices at the end of prompts and ask models to generate answers. Thus, classification tasks can be treated as a special case of generation tasks.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers and step-by-step explanations for reasoning tasks.

answer_2.quote: we use ROUGE-L to measure the performance of both classification and generation tasks and report the aggregated score. Similar to , we also use exact-match score which is more suitable for tasks with short answers. Additionally, we compute relaxed-match score which is a relaxed version of exact-match.
